children: Solana-based token issuance platform StonkFun generated $4.85 million in protocol revenue over the past seven days, according to DeFiLlama data. According to ChainCatcher, this put StonkFun ahead of Robinhood-linked meme coin issuance platform Pons, which recorded $4.39 million, and ranked it 10th on the protocol revenue list.

title: StonkFun Protocol Revenue Reaches $4.85 Million in Seven Days, Surpassing Pons
